classification.description: Doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors (aluminium)

origin_result.basis: No origin checks could be run because the required data was not provided. The tool reported status INSUFFICIENT_DATA with no checks and no totals. Missing: a bill of materials (each input's description, 6-digit HS code, origin country, value and currency) and a declaration (product price, FOB or Ex-Works basis, final manufacture in the UAE, operations done in the UAE).

procedure.step: Register the factory through the Factory Registration service; registration requires the factory to be located outside a free zone, a MoIAT industrial licence, and a MoIAT letter confirming 40% domestic value added, and takes about 3 working days.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: Log in to the ministry e-services portal, choose the Certificate of Origin for India service, fill in the application form, upload the required documents, pay the fee online, and submit the application.
The application must include the HS code, description, quantity and value of the exported product; each item on the certificate must qualify separately in its own right.
The certificate fee depends on the invoice value in AED, ranging from AED 10 to AED 200.
Receive approval, or a return with comments to correct; print the approved certificate.
The certificate shall be issued prior to, at or within five working days of the date of exportation, and is valid for twelve months from the date of issue for only one import.
Ship the goods directly from the UAE to India; transit through another country is allowed only under customs control with no operations other than unloading, reloading, storage or similar.
The Indian importer claims the CEPA rate when filing the bill of entry and must hold origin information under CAROTAR 2020, including which origin criterion is claimed.
Keep origin records, including the cost breakdown, for at least five years, starting from the end of the year of the date of issue.

caveats.note: The '+' in the rule is read as 'and' (both tests must pass); the agreement does not define '+', so this is Mansha's interpretation.
'Direct labour cost' and 'direct overhead cost' are not defined in the agreement.
The CEPA rate reduces Basic Customs Duty (BCD) only; IGST, GST compensation cess, Social Welfare Surcharge and any anti-dumping or safeguard duty still apply.

No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.
That electronic certificates are accepted and uploaded to India's e-Sanchit system comes from secondary sources, not the official text.
A producer in a free zone is likely not eligible for Factory Registration, which is a prerequisite for the certificate of origin.
Interpretation: de minimis helps only the tariff-shift part of a rule, not the VA percentage.
Operations listed in the agreement's minimal operations article, alone or combined, never make a product originating, whatever the product-specific rule says.
The agreement does not say whether the build-down and build-up value-addition methods use the same threshold, apart from the 5-point Ex-Works adjustment.

follow_up_questions: Provide a bill of materials with the description, 6-digit HS code, origin country, value and currency of each input used in production.
Provide a declaration stating the product price, whether it is on an FOB or Ex-Works basis, that final manufacture occurred in the UAE, and what operations were done in the UAE.
Provide the shipment value in AED.
